info.title: Dink Smallwood HD
info.author: Seth A. Robinson, type0labs
info.description: Native Switch port of the 1997 action-RPG by Seth Robinson.
info.details:
Dink Smallwood HD for Nintendo Switch.

Originally created by Robinson Technologies (Seth A. Robinson) in 1997, Dink Smallwood is an isometric action-RPG following a pig farmer turned hero on an epic, humorous quest.

This port brings the complete HD version to the Nintendo Switch with gamepad controls, full high-quality MIDI soundtrack synthesis, and dual English / Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) language support.

Features:
- Native 60 FPS gameplay
- Full Joy-Con and Pro Controller mapping
- Real-time software MIDI synthesis
- Bilingual: English and Portuguese (PT-BR) first-boot selection

Controls:
- D-Pad / Left Stick: Movement
- A: Talk / Attack / Confirm
- B: Magic / Cancel
- X: Inventory / Status
- Y: Use Item
- Plus / Minus: Menu / Map
